analysis.primary: For each of three physical pairs and two providers, test whether the mirrored response distribution equals the original after swapping advance and retard; block-stratified conditional response tests; Holm across six pair/provider tests. 19999 conditional Monte Carlo null tables per test, fixed analysis seeds.
analysis.secondary: Six untransformed original/mirror input-dependence tests, with a separate Holm family; marginal Wilson 95% action intervals descriptive.
analysis.effect: Report g_original, g_mirror, even=(g_original+g_mirror)/2, odd=(g_mirror-g_original)/2, and total variation from reflection covariance.
analysis.forecasts: Score the previously frozen updated first_state and three_state models, separating original and mirror inputs; no refitting.
analysis.replication: Per-block distributions plus current originals versus the earlier original fields; historical counts are not pooled into primary tests.

invalid_policy: No outcome-adaptive top-ups. Keep malformed returned responses; at most three transport attempts; dispatch journal before send; unknown usage remains reserved.
